title: Marathi Animal Names: 40 Animals with Hindi & English
description: 40 Marathi animal names — pets, farm animals, wildlife and birds — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and example sentences.
intro: Forty Marathi animal names from the Bol Marathi curriculum: pets like कुत्रा and मांजर, farm animals like गाय and म्हैस, wildlife like वाघ and हत्ती, birds from कावळा to मोर, and even the small ones — मुंगी (ant) and फुलपाखरू (butterfly). Every entry carries its Hindi meaning, English meaning, pronunciation and a real example sentence.

Hindi speakers get a head start here, but not a free pass: गाय is identical, घोडा is near-identical, yet a cat is मांजर, not बिल्ली, and a dog softens to कुत्रा. The familiar-looking words and the genuinely new ones are mixed together in the table below — check each against the Hindi column instead of assuming.
tip: Learn in habitat groups: house (कुत्रा, मांजर), farm (गाय, म्हैस, बकरी), jungle (वाघ, सिंह, हत्ती), sky (पोपट, कावळा, गरुड).

sections.heading: For Hindi speakers: familiar, but not identical
paragraphs: Several Marathi animal words are Hindi words with a sound shift: कुत्ता → कुत्रा, हाथी → हत्ती, खरगोश → ससा is a full replacement, and चूहा → उंदीर. The pattern to trust: if the Marathi word looks like a softened Hindi word, it usually means the same thing (कुत्रा, हत्ती, घोडा). If it looks unrelated (ससा, म्हैस, मांजर), learn it fresh.
Marathi also marks gender explicitly in animal pairs: घोडा (horse) / घोडी (mare), and हरण (deer) beside हरीण (stag). The table below shows both where both exist.

sections.heading: How to use this list
paragraphs: Work group by group, saying each word aloud with its example sentence. Then open Unit 14 (Nature & Travel), where these words appear inside full lessons about landscapes and wildlife.

mistakes.why: Hindi बाघ (tiger) and शेर (lion) look nothing like the Marathi pair, so learners mix them up. वाघ is tiger.
पक्षी is the category word — the word for the whole group, not one species.

mistakes.wrong: Writing घोडी for a male horse
mistakes.why: Marathi keeps an explicit feminine form here; Hindi घोड़ी exists too but English 'horse' hides the gender.

mcq.question: How do you say “dog” in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: कुत्रा (kutrā) — a softened cousin of Hindi कुत्ता.

mcq.question: What does वाघ mean?
mcq.explanation: वाघ (vāgh) = tiger. Lion is सिंह.

mcq.question: फुलपाखरू means…
mcq.explanation: फुलपाखरू (phulpākharū) = butterfly; मधमाशी is the honeybee.

fill.hint: Not a sound shift — a different word entirely.

faq.question: How many animal words are on this page?
faq.answer: 40 — pets, farm animals, wildlife, birds and insects, each with Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and an example sentence.

faq.question: Is Marathi animal vocabulary the same as Hindi?
faq.answer: Partly. Words like गाय and घोडा carry over; कुत्रा and हत्ती are sound-shifted; मांजर (cat), ससा (rabbit) and म्हैस (buffalo) are different words you must learn fresh.

title: Marathi Weather Words: Rain, Seasons & Climate
description: 16 Marathi weather and season words — पाऊस, ऊन, वारा, हवामान and the four seasons — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and example sentences.
intro: Sixteen Marathi words for talking about the sky: the four seasons (उन्हाळा, पावसाळा, हिवाळा, वसंत), rain, sunshine, wind and clouds, plus useful everyday words like छत्री (umbrella) and हवामान (weather itself). Each entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and an example sentence.

Weather is the safest small-talk topic in any language, and Marathi is no exception. A handful of these words — पाऊस आला, खूप ऊन आहे, वारा आहे — carry a whole conversation with a neighbour, a rickshaw driver or a colleague.
tip: Anchor the four seasons to the Maharashtra calendar: पावसाळा (monsoon) arrives in June — the season Maharashtra talks about most.

sections.heading: The four seasons
paragraphs: उन्हाळा (summer), पावसाळा (monsoon), हिवाळा (winter), वसंत (spring). Note the -आळा ending on three of them — once you hear the pattern, the season words stop needing memorization.
Monsoon matters in Maharashtra: curriculum sentences like वर्षात पावस खूप पडतो (it rains a lot in the rainy season) from Unit 16 are the kind of line you will actually hear.

sections.heading: Hindi speakers: watch out for हवा
paragraphs: In Hindi, हवा usually means wind. In Marathi, wind is वारा — and हवा means air. The false friend is easy to trip on precisely because the word is familiar; the table below marks wind clearly as वारा.

mistakes.why: The most common false friend on this page for Hindi speakers.

mistakes.wrong: Using उन्हाळा to say “it is hot”
mistakes.right: उन्हाळा = the summer season; heat itself is उष्णता, and sunshine is ऊन
mistakes.why: Season name vs. weather condition — different words.

mistakes.right: थंडी = cold weather; a cold (illness) is सर्दी
mistakes.why: Hindi merges these; Marathi separates the weather from the sickness.

mcq.question: How do you say “rain” in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: पाऊस (pāūs) = rain; the season is पावसाळा.

mcq.question: हिवाळा means…
mcq.explanation: हिवाळा (hivāḷā) = winter.

mcq.question: What is धुकं?
mcq.explanation: धुकं (dhuka) = fog; a storm is वादळ and lightning is वीज.

fill.hint: Patterned on Unit 16: वर्षात पावस खूप पडतो.

faq.question: What are the four seasons in Marathi?
faq.answer: उन्हाळा (summer), पावसाळा (monsoon), हिवाळा (winter) and वसंत (spring) — three end in -आळा, which makes them easy to remember as a set.

faq.question: How do you say “weather” in Marathi?
faq.answer: हवामान (havāmān). Rain is पाऊस, wind is वारा, and sunshine is ऊन.

title: Marathi Clothes Vocabulary: Clothing & Jewellery Words
description: 38 Marathi clothing words — everyday wear, traditional clothes like साडी, धोतर and पगडी, plus jewellery — with Hindi, English, pronunciation and examples.
intro: Thirty-eight Marathi clothing words in two layers: everyday and modern wear (शर्ट, पँट, जीन्स, चप्पल) and traditional Maharashtrian clothing and jewellery (साडी, धोतर, पगडी, नथ, बांगड्या). Each entry carries Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and an example sentence.

Notice how freely Marathi absorbs loanwords: शर्ट, जाकीट, रेनकोट, टीशर्ट. That is real, everyday Marathi — you do not need to hunt for “pure” words nobody uses. The traditional half of the list is where genuinely Marathi vocabulary lives.
tip: Pair this list with the shopping pages — clothing words become useful the moment you can ask हे किती आहे? (how much is this?).

sections.heading: Traditional Maharashtrian wear
paragraphs: धोतर, पगडी, सदरा and ओढणी are words you will hear at festivals, weddings and in older parts of any Maharashtrian city. नववारी साडी पाहिली असेल तर — the nine-yard sari — साडी is the everyday word.
Jewellery has its own mini-cluster: कानातले (earrings), नथ (nose ring), बांगड्या (bangles), अंगठी (ring). These are high-frequency words in festival and wedding conversation.

sections.heading: For Hindi speakers
paragraphs: Most clothing words carry over cleanly (कुर्ता, पायजामा, दुपट्टा are shared), but watch जोडा: in Marathi it means a pair of footwear specifically, not a generic pair. And पँट is the everyday word for trousers.

mistakes.right: जोडा = a pair of footwear; for other pairs use जोडी
mistakes.why: Narrower than Hindi जोड़ा.
Both go on the head; only पगडी is the traditional wrapped turban.

mistakes.wrong: Hunting for “pure Marathi” for शर्ट or जीन्स
mistakes.why: शर्ट, जीन्स, टीशर्ट are the words people actually say.

mcq.question: How do you say “sari” in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: साडी (sāḍī) — same word, same garment.

mcq.question: चप्पल means…
mcq.explanation: चप्पल (chappal). Boots for rain are गमबूट.

mcq.question: What are बांगड्या?
mcq.explanation: बांगड्या (bāṅgaḍyā) = bangles.

fill.hint: टोपी = cap; पगडी = turban — different words.

faq.question: How do you say “clothes” in Marathi?
faq.answer: कपडे (kapaḍe). Individual items: शर्ट (shirt), पँट (trousers), साडी (sari), चप्पल (sandals) — 38 words in the table above.

faq.question: Which Marathi clothing words are unique to Maharashtra?
faq.answer: धोतर, पगडी, नऊवारी-style साडी vocabulary, सदरा and ओढणी are the traditional words; modern items like शर्ट and जीन्स are loanwords used as-is.

title: Marathi Emotion Words: Say How You Feel
description: 20 Marathi words for emotions and inner states — आनंद, राग, भीती, काळजी — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation, examples and the मला…आहे pattern.
intro: Twenty Marathi words for how you feel — from आनंद (happiness) and दुःख (sorrow) to the useful in-between states: कंटाळा (boredom), थकवा (tiredness), काळजी (worry). Several entries here are body-states too — भूक (hunger), तहान (thirst), झोप (sleepiness) — because Marathi, like Hindi, talks about them as things that happen to you.

That grammar matters as much as the words: feelings and body-states usually take the मला … आहे pattern (literally “to me is…”), which is why this page pairs with Unit 17 and the emotions lessons where sentences like मला थोडं दुःख आहे appear.
tip: Learn feelings in opposite pairs: आनंद/दुःख, भीती/धैर्य, कंटाळा/उत्साह — pairs stick better than lists.

sections.heading: The मला … आहे pattern
paragraphs: Many Marathi feeling sentences put the feeling as the subject and the person in the dative: मला राग आला (I got angry), मला भीती वाटते (I feel afraid), मला भूक लागली आहे (I am hungry). Translating word-for-word from English (“I am hungry”) produces Marathi nobody says.
Unit 17 drills exactly this: मी आज खूप आनंदी आहे for states you are, and मला … for states that come over you.

sections.heading: For Hindi speakers: राग is a trap
paragraphs: In Hindi, राग is a musical mode. In Marathi, राग means anger. The word is identical, the meaning is not — and it is one of the highest-frequency feeling words in Marathi. Same story, smaller stakes, with हसू (laughter, a noun — Hindi speakers expect हँसना).

mistakes.why: Hunger, thirst and fear arrive “to you” in Marathi — the dative pattern, like Hindi मुझे भूख लगी है.

mistakes.wrong: Using राग to talk about music
mistakes.why: False friend: Hindi राग (melody) ≠ Marathi राग (anger).
Standard Marathi keeps the ः; writing दुख is the Hindi spelling habit.

mcq.question: How do you say “anger” in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: राग (rāg) = anger — not music, as in Hindi.

mcq.question: भीती means…
mcq.explanation: भीती (bhītī) = fear; it takes the dative: मला भीती वाटते.

mcq.question: Which word means “worry”?
mcq.explanation: काळजी (kāḷjī) = worry; it can also mean “care” in care-taking contexts.

translate.note: From Unit 17 — आनंदी (happy) is the adjective form of आनंद.

faq.question: How do you say “I am sad” in Marathi?
faq.answer: मला दुःख आहे or मी दुःखी आहे — the curriculum sentence is मला थोडं दुःख आहे (I feel a little sad), using the dative मला pattern natural for feelings.

faq.question: What is the Marathi word for love?
faq.answer: प्रेम (prem) — same as Hindi प्यार’s formal cousin. Family affection appears in sentences like आईला खूप प्रेम आहे.

title: Marathi Body Parts: 43 Words from Head to Toe
description: 43 Marathi body-part and health words — डोकं to टाच, plus symptoms and doctor-visit vocabulary — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and examples.
intro: Forty-three Marathi words covering the body head to toe — डोकं (head) down to टाच (heel) — plus the health vocabulary that makes them useful: दुखणं (pain), ताप (fever), औषध (medicine), रुग्ण (patient). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and an example sentence.

This list earns its keep at the doctor: Unit 10 sentences like माझं डोके दुखते (my head hurts) are built from these words, so the table below doubles as symptom-reporting vocabulary. Learn the body part together with the pattern, and you can describe what hurts without grammar overhead.
tip: Point and name while washing up or dressing — हात, पाय, डोकं three times a day beats one long study session.

sections.heading: The “it hurts” pattern
paragraphs: Marathi says माझं डोके दुखते — literally “my head hurts”, with the body part as the subject. So the sentence frame you need is माझं/माझे + body part + दुखते. The same frame extends to symptoms: मला ताप आहे (I have fever), मला खोकला आहे (I have a cough).
For Hindi speakers this is familiar territory: मेरा सिर दुख रहा है maps closely. The Marathi-specific part is which words changed — डोकं for सिर, पोट for पेट, खोकला for खाँसी.

sections.heading: Two-for-one words
paragraphs: पाय covers both leg and foot; बोट covers both finger and toe; हात covers hand and arm. Context disambiguates — and plural बोटं, पाय appear constantly in everyday speech.

mistakes.why: Symptoms take the dative मला pattern in the curriculum (मला ताप आहे, खांसीही आहे — Unit 10).

mistakes.wrong: Translating “I have a headache” word for word
mistakes.right: डोकेदुखी आहे मला, or माझं डोके दुखते
mistakes.why: The thing hurts; you don’t “have” the pain — Marathi prefers the body part as subject.
औषध जेवणानंतर घ्या (take medicine after food) vs. counting गोळया.

mcq.question: How do you say “eye” in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: डोळा (ḍoḷā) — one of several fully Marathi words where Hindi uses आँख.

mcq.question: पोट means…
mcq.explanation: पोट (poṭ) = stomach — hence डॉक्टर, माझं पोट दुखते.

mcq.question: What is औषध?
mcq.explanation: औषध (auṣadh) = medicine; आरोग्य is health.

translate.note: Straight from Unit 10 — body part as the subject.

faq.question: How many body words are on this page?
faq.answer: 43 — body parts from head to toe plus symptom and doctor-visit vocabulary (fever, medicine, patient, treatment), each with Hindi, English and an example.

faq.question: How do you say “my head hurts” in Marathi?
faq.answer: माझं डोके दुखते — the body part is the subject. The same frame works for पोट (stomach), पाठ (back) and कान (ear).

title: Marathi Nature Words: Trees, Rivers, Sky & Earth
description: 47 Marathi nature words — plants, landforms, water, sky and soil — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and example sentences from Unit 14.
intro: Forty-seven Marathi nature words from the Bol Marathi curriculum: trees (झाड, वड, पिंपळ), flowers (फूल, गुलाब, मोगरा), landforms (शिखर, दरी, बेट, वाळवंट), water bodies (तलाव, धबधबा, समुद्रकिनारा), and the sky above (सूर्य, चंद्र, तारा, आकाश). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.

Hindi speakers will recognize many Sanskrit-rooted words (पर्यावरण, प्रदूषण, हिम) but should note the soft shifts: पेड़ → झाड, तालाब → तलाव, चोटी → शिखर. The table below pairs each so you learn the difference once.
tip: Learn in habitat layers: ground (माती, दगड, वाळू), water (तलाव, धबधबा, विहीर), sky (सूर्य, चंद्र, तारा) — the curriculum sentences in Unit 14 follow exactly this layering.

sections.heading: Sacred trees and festival flowers
paragraphs: Maharashtra's landscape is marked by trees with cultural weight: वड (banyan), पिंपळ (peepal), तुळस (holy basil), मोगरा (jasmine), झेंडू (marigold). You will hear these at weddings, festivals and daily rituals — they are not decorative vocabulary, they are cultural landmarks.

sections.heading: For Hindi speakers: soft shifts, not free passes
paragraphs: Words like हिम (ice/snow), पर्यावरण (environment), प्रदूषण (pollution) are shared. But पेड़ becomes झाड, तालाब becomes तलाव, बीज becomes बी. Learn the shifted forms; the shared ones will reinforce themselves.

mistakes.why: The classic false friend — Hindi पान (betel leaf) and पानी (water) sound close; Marathi separates them cleanly: पान (leaf), पाणी (water).
Hindi दरवाजा shortens to दरी in casual speech; Marathi keeps the full word for door and uses दरी only for valley.

mistakes.right: वाळू = sand; रेत is also used in formal contexts
mistakes.why: वाळू is the everyday word; रेत appears in writing. Both valid; वाळू is what you will hear on a beach.

mcq.question: How do you say “waterfall” in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: धबधबा (dhabdhabā) — onomatopoeic, like the sound of falling water.

mcq.question: What is आंब्याचं झाड?
mcq.explanation: आंब्याचं झाड = mango tree (आंबा = mango + झाड = tree).

mcq.question: रेगिस्तान in Marathi is…
mcq.explanation: वाळवंट (vāḷvaṇṭ) — literally “sand-forest”, the desert.

fill.hint: The Sahyadris are forested — use the tree word.

translate.source: The sun rises in the east.

faq.question: How many nature words are on this page?
faq.answer: 47 — covering trees, flowers, landforms, water, sky and soil, each with Hindi meaning, pronunciation and a sentence.

faq.question: What is the Marathi word for “tree”?
faq.answer: झाड (jhāḍ). The Hindi word पेड़ shifts to झाड in Marathi.

title: Marathi School & Education Words: 38 Terms
description: Marathi school words — classroom, exams, subjects, degrees — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation, examples from Unit 11.
intro: Thirty-eight Marathi words for school and education life: classroom (वर्ग, तुकडी), exams (परीक्षा, गुण), subjects (गणित, विज्ञान, भूगोल), degrees (पदवी, गुणपत्रक) and the everyday tools (वही, पेन्सिल, टिफिन). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.
Unit 11 anchors this vocabulary in real situations: interviews, projects, promotions — the curriculum sentences like मी इंजिनिअरिंग शिकत आहे and मला प्रमोशन मिळालं show these words in action.
tip: Group by the student journey: admission (प्रवेश, शुल्क) → study (अभ्यास, धडा, विषय) → exam (परीक्षा, उत्तर) → result (गुण, गुणपत्रक, पदवी).

sections.heading: The exam pipeline
paragraphs: प्रवेश (admission) → शुल्क (fees) → अभ्यासक्रम (syllabus) → परीक्षा (exam) → गुण (marks) → गुणपत्रक (report card) → पदवी (degree). Each word is a milestone; the sentences in Unit 11 walk you through the whole sequence.

sections.heading: Subjects cluster
paragraphs: गणित (mathematics), विज्ञान (science), भूगोल (geography), नागरिकशास्त्र (civics), शारीरिक शिक्षण (physical education) — the -शास्त्र ending marks formal subjects, making them easy to recognize and extend.

mistakes.why: Same word, two unrelated meanings — context tells you which. The direction word appears in the Directions category (v-dir-04).
गुण alone is the score; गुणपत्रक is the document. Hindi अंकपत्र follows the same pattern.

mistakes.right: परीक्षा = formal exam; small tests are लहान परीक्षा or टेस्ट
mistakes.why: परीक्षा carries weight; casual quizzes borrow टेस्ट.

mcq.question: What is “library” in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: ग्रंथालय (granthālay) — literally “book-place”.

mcq.question: गुणपत्रक means…
mcq.explanation: गुणपत्रक (guṇpatrak) = marks-sheet / report card.

mcq.question: Which word means “scholarship”?
mcq.explanation: शिष्यवृत्ती (śiṣyavṛttī) — student + growth.

translate.note: Unit 11 sentence — present continuous for ongoing study.

faq.question: How many education words are on this page?
faq.answer: 38 — covering classroom, exams, subjects, tools, degrees and the whole student journey, with Hindi meanings and sentences.

faq.question: What is the Marathi word for “exam”?
faq.answer: परीक्षा (parīkṣā) — same as Hindi परीक्षा.

title: Marathi Office & Work Words: Jobs, Salary, Meetings
description: 42 Marathi office vocabulary words — नोकरी, पगार, traditional occupations — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation, examples from Units 11, 19.
h1: Marathi Work & Office Words (काम आणि कार्यालय)
intro: Forty-two Marathi work and office words spanning modern roles (अभियंता, वकील, संगणक) and traditional occupations (सुतार, लोहार, सोनार, शिंपी, न्हावी). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.

Many Marathi surnames come from these occupations — सुतार, लोहार, शिंपी, धोबी are both job titles and family names. The list also covers the modern office: पगार (salary), बैठक (meeting), सुट्टी (leave), बिल (bill). Unit 19 sentences like माझा धंदा चांगला चालत आहे put them in context.
tip: The occupation words double as surnames — knowing सुतार means “carpenter” helps you recognize the surname Sutār in introductions.

sections.heading: Traditional occupations — surnames you will meet
paragraphs: सुतार (carpenter), लोहार (blacksmith), सोनार (goldsmith), शिंपी (tailor), न्हावी (barber), धोबी (washerman), माळी (gardener), गवळी (milkman) — these are living surnames across Maharashtra. The vocabulary row and the family name are identical.

sections.heading: Modern office essentials
paragraphs: नोकरी (job), पगार (salary), बैठक (meeting), सुट्टी (leave), संगणक (computer), बिल (bill), रोख (cash), पावती (receipt) — the words you need for your first day, your payslip and your resignation.

mistakes.why: Hindi सिपाही = soldier; Marathi शिपाई is the office attendant. The soldier is सैनिक — a direct false friend.
मला काम आहे (I have work to do) vs माझी नोकरी आहे (I have a job). Hindi काम/नौकरी follows the same split.

mistakes.wrong: Calling a barber न्हावी in formal writing
mistakes.right: नाई is the formal term; न्हावी is colloquial
mistakes.why: Both exist; नाई appears in official contexts.

mcq.question: What is “salary” in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: पगार (pagār) — same root as Hindi वेतन/पगार.

title: Marathi Festival & Culture Words: Diwali to Gudi Padwa
description: 32 Marathi festival words — गुढीपाडवा, गणपती, वारी, रांगोळी and more — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation, examples from Unit 13.
h1: Marathi Festival & Culture Words (संस्कृती आणि सण)
intro: Thirty-two Marathi festival and culture words — the big celebrations (गुढीपाडवा, गणपती, दिवाळी, होळी), the rituals (पूजा, आरती, प्रसाद, उपवास), the arts (रांगोळी, भजन, कीर्तन) and the pilgrimages (यात्रा, वारी). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.

Unit 13 sentences like सर्वांना शुभ दिवाळी! and मी गणपतीला भेट देईन show these words in living use. Maharashtra's public गणपती उत्सव is a cultural institution — knowing the vocabulary lets you participate, not just watch.
tip: गुढीपाडवा is the Marathi New Year (not Diwali) — learn it first; it unlocks the calendar.

sections.heading: Maharashtra-specific celebrations
paragraphs: गुढीपाडवा (Marathi New Year), शिवजयंती (Shivaji Jayanti), वारी (the Pandharpur pilgrimage) — these are distinctly Maharashtrian. The public गणपती उत्सव (ten days, streets full of idols, processions) is unlike any other state's celebration.

sections.heading: Ritual vocabulary that travels
paragraphs: पूजा, आरती, प्रसाद, रांगोळी, तोरण, फराळ, उपवास — these words work across festivals. Learn them once; they repeat every celebration.

mistakes.right: दिवाळी (with ळ) is the Marathi spelling
mistakes.why: The ळ sound is Marathi's signature; writing दिवाली marks the word as Hindi, not Marathi.

mistakes.right: फराळ = festive snacks eaten DURING fasts (फलाहार)
mistakes.why: The word refers to the special treats (पेढे, लाडू, चकली), not the fast itself. The fast is उपवास.

mistakes.right: वारी = pilgrimage (to Pandharpur); the festival is आषाढी एकादशी
mistakes.why: वारी is the journey; the day is the festival. Pilgrims walk weeks — it is a verb-noun hybrid.

faq.question: How do you say “festival” in Marathi?

title: Marathi Adjectives: 68 Describing Words
description: 68 Marathi adjectives — size, quality, temperature, difficulty, opposites — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation, gender agreement, examples from Unit 3.
intro: Sixty-eight Marathi adjectives covering size (मोठा/लहान), quality (चांगला/वाईट), temperature (गरम/थंड), difficulty (सोपं/अवघड) and opposite pairs (उघडा/बंद, कोरडा/ओला, जड/हलका). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.

Unit 3 teaches adjective agreement: मोठा (masculine), मोठी (feminine), मोठे (neuter). The table below gives the masculine citation form; the possessives page (माझा/माझी/माझे) shows the same pattern — learn them together.
tip: Learn opposite pairs together: मोठा/लहान, चांगला/वाईट, गरम/थंड, उघडा/बंद — pairs stick faster than singles.

sections.heading: Gender agreement — the one rule to watch
paragraphs: Adjectives ending in -ा (मोठा) change to -ी (मोठी) for feminine nouns and -े (मोठे) for neuter. The noun decides — माझा मोठा घर (my big house, neuter) but माझी मोठी बहीण (my big sister, feminine). The possessives page drills this exact pattern.

sections.heading: Opposite pairs you will use daily
paragraphs: उघडा/बंद (open/closed), कोरडा/ओला (dry/wet), जड/हलका (heavy/light), मऊ/कडक (soft/hard), रुंद/अरुंद (wide/narrow), खोल/उंच (deep/tall). Each pair is a ready-made mini-lesson.

mistakes.wrong: Using मोठा with a feminine noun
mistakes.right: मोठी बहीण (big sister) — adjective matches noun gender
mistakes.why: The citation form मोठा is masculine; feminine nouns take मोठी, neuter take मोठे.

mistakes.right: थंड = cold (adjective); थंडी = cold weather / winter (noun, feminine)
mistakes.why: Weather page uses थंडी as noun; here थंड is the describing word.

mistakes.wrong: Writing चांगला for a neuter noun
mistakes.why: Same agreement rule as possessives: माझे, चांगले, सोपे.

mcq.question: How do you say “small” in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: लहान (lahān) — opposite of मोठा.

mcq.question: Fast in Marathi is…
mcq.explanation: जलद (jalad) = fast; opposite is हळू (slow).

mcq.question: Which pair means “easy / difficult”?
mcq.explanation: सोपं = easy, अवघड = difficult.

faq.question: Do Marathi adjectives change for gender?
faq.answer: Yes — masculine ends in -ा (मोठा), feminine in -ी (मोठी), neuter in -े (मोठे). The noun's gender decides the form.

title: Marathi Adverbs: Always, Never, Slowly, Together
description: 30 Marathi adverbs — frequency, time, manner, degree — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and Unit 18 sentence examples.
intro: Thirty Marathi adverbs for how often (नेहमी, कधीच, कधीकधी), when (आता, लवकर, उशिरा), how (हळूहळू, जोरात, नीट, चुकून, मुद्दाम) and degree (फक्त, खरंच, नक्की, कदाचित, जवळजवळ). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.
Unit 18 places adverbs right before the verb: मी रोज क्रिकेट खेळतो, मला कधीकधी वाचन आवडतं. The pattern is consistent — learn the position once, apply to all.
tip: नेहमी (always) vs कधीच (never) — one letter च flips the meaning. कधी = when; कधी+च = never.

sections.heading: Frequency ladder
paragraphs: नेहमी (always) → कधीकधी (sometimes) → कधीच (never). Add रोज (daily) and अजून (still) for the full daily spectrum.

sections.heading: Directional adverbs from inside/outside
paragraphs: बाहेरून (from outside), आतून (from inside), वरून (from above), खालून (from below), समोरून (from the front) — spatial adverbs built from direction words + the -ऊन suffix.

mistakes.wrong: Using अजून for “yet” in negative sentences
mistakes.why: The emphatic ही adds the “up to now” nuance Hindi speakers expect from अभी तक.
The च particle negates — a tiny suffix, a total meaning flip.

mistakes.right: Adverb sits before the verb: मी रोज खेळतो (not मी खेळतो रोज)
mistakes.why: Unit 18 pattern — adverbs pre-verb, consistently.

mcq.explanation: नेहमी (nehmi) = always.

mcq.question: कधीच means…
mcq.explanation: कधीच (kadhīc) = never (कधी + च).

faq.answer: Before the verb — मी रोज खेळतो, मला कधीकधी आवडतं. Unit 18 drills this position consistently.

title: Marathi Connectors: And, But, Because & More
description: 32 Marathi conjunctions and connectors — pronouns, demonstratives — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and examples.
intro: Thirty-two Marathi connectors and core grammar words: conjunctions (आणि, पण, कारण, म्हणून, जर, तर, किंवा, आधी, नंतर), demonstratives (हा, ही, हे, इथे, तिथे), pronouns (तो, ती, ते, कोण, कशा) and quantifiers (काही, सर्व, प्रत्येक). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.
These are the mortar between vocabulary bricks — Unit 4 sentence patterns and Unit 21 advanced grammar both build on them. The possessives page (माझा/माझी) shares the demonstrative roots.
tip: जर…तर = if…then pair — always appears together in conditional sentences. Memorize the pair, not the parts.

sections.heading: The conditional pair
paragraphs: जर पाऊस आला, तर मी घरी राहीन (if rain comes, then I stay home). जर introduces the condition, तर the consequence — drop either and the logic breaks.

sections.heading: Demonstratives you already know
paragraphs: हा/ही/हे (this), तो/ती/ते (that), इथे/तिथे (here/there) — the near/far and gender system mirrors possessives (माझा/माझी/माझे, तो/ती/ते). Learn one set, the other follows.

mistakes.why: Spoken Marathi uses पण exclusively; परंतु appears in official letters and literature.
The curriculum treats them as a fixed pair — Unit 4 conditional sentences always show both.

mistakes.right: आणि is correct for lists; commas work too
mistakes.why: आणि is the standard coordinator; no mistake, just noting it is the only “and” you need.

mcq.question: How do you say “but” in everyday Marathi?
mcq.explanation: पण (paṇ) — the everyday but; परंतु is formal.

mcq.question: म्हणून means…
mcq.explanation: म्हणून (mhaṇūn) = therefore / so; कारण is because.

mcq.question: The pair for “if…then” is…
mcq.explanation: जर…तर (jar…tar) — fixed conditional pair.

translate.note: Unit 21 compound word — the classic 쌍.

faq.question: What are the most common Marathi conjunctions?
faq.answer: आणि (and), पण (but), कारण (because), म्हणून (therefore), जर…तर (if…then) — the five that carry most sentences.

faq.question: How do you say “or” in Marathi?
faq.answer: किंवा (kīṃvā) — same as Hindi कि or या.

title: Marathi Transport Words: Train, Bus, Auto & More
description: 25 Marathi transport words — train, bus, auto, ticket, platform and direction words — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and Unit 15 travel sentences.
intro: Twenty-five Marathi transport words covering rail (आगगाडी, रेल्वे, स्टेशन, प्लॅटफॉर्म, तिकीट), road (बस, ऑटो, रिक्षा, गाडी, दुचाकी, सायकल), air (विमान, विमानतळ), and directions (डावा, उजवा, सरळ, थांबा). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.
Unit 15 sentences like मुंबईला जाणारा ट्रेन कोणता? and ऑटो घेऊन स्टेशनला गेले put these words in the exact exchanges you will have at stations and on streets.
tip: आगगाडी is the native word for train; ट्रेन and रेल्वे are equally common in daily speech. Use whichever comes naturally.

sections.heading: The station triangle
paragraphs: स्टेशन (station) + प्लॅटफॉर्म (platform) + तिकीट (ticket) — the three words that get you on the train. Add आगगाडी (train) and आप have the full rail vocabulary.

sections.heading: Street transport
paragraphs: ऑटो/रिक्षा (auto rickshaw), बस (bus), टॅक्सी (taxi), दुचाकी (two-wheeler), सायकल (bicycle) — the words for the last-mile journey from station to destination.

mistakes.why: Cross-category polyseme — the travel word बोट (boat) and the body word बोट (finger) are identical. Context disambiguates.

mistakes.right: रेल्वे = railway system; आगगाडी/ट्रेन = the train
mistakes.why: रेल्वे is the network; the moving vehicle is आगगाडी or ट्रेन.
Hindi बायाँ/दायाँ have no sound overlap — these are fresh learning.

faq.question: What is the word for “auto rickshaw”?
faq.answer: ऑटो or रिक्षा — both used interchangeably.

tip: भाजी means BOTH vegetable and curry — context tells you which. At the market, एक किलो भाजी द्या = one kilo of vegetables; at home, भाजी तयार आहे = the curry is ready.

sections.heading: Market quantities
paragraphs: एक किलो (one kilo), आधा किलो (half kilo), पाव किलो (250g), दोन किलो (two kilo) — the numbers you need before the noun. Unit 9 drills exactly this: एक किलो भाजी द्या.

sections.heading: Seasonality note
paragraphs: आंबा (mango) is summer; संत्रं (orange) is winter; केळं (banana) year-round. Vendors will tell you काय सुरु आहे? (what's in season?) — learn the cycle, not just the names.

mistakes.wrong: Using भाजी for a single vegetable
mistakes.right: भाजी = vegetable (category) AND curry; for a single item say बटाटा, कांदा, टोमॅटो

intro: Twenty-five Marathi household words — the room (घर, खोली), the fixtures (दार, खिडकी, दिवा, आरसा), the furniture (टेबल, खुर्ची, पलंग), and the everyday carry (चावी, पैसा, मोबाईल, बूट). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.

The daily-life cluster page mixes 5 categories; this page isolates the home subset so you can learn the room-by-room vocabulary without distraction. Units 2 and 3 sentences like पुस्तक बॅगमध्ये आहे and माझी खोली स्वच्छ आहे put these words in context.
tip: खोली = room (specific); घर = house/building (whole). Hindi कमरा/घर follows the same split — the distinction carries over.

sections.heading: Room vs house
paragraphs: माझी खोली स्वच्छ आहे (my room is clean) vs माझे घर मोठे आहे (my house is big). The agreement follows the noun — खोली (feminine) takes माझी/स्वच्छ, घर (neuter) takes माझे/मोठे.

sections.heading: Mirrors and keys — Hindi speakers take note
paragraphs: आरसा (mirror) vs Hindi आईना — completely different word. चावी (key) vs Hindi चाबी — same root, Marathi spelling. Both are high-frequency in daily instructions: आरसा बघा (look in the mirror), चावी द्या (give the key).

mistakes.why: Same distinction as Hindi घर/कमरा — mixing them makes you sound like you live in one room.
One of the clearest Hindi→Marathi swaps on this page — no sound overlap, must learn fresh.

title: Marathi Health Symptoms: Pain, Fever, Cough & More

sections.heading: The मला … आहे pattern

sections.heading: Pain locations — body part + दुखते

mistakes.why: Symptoms take the dative मला pattern: मला ताप आहे, मला खोकला आहे — Unit 10 curriculum.
Marathi uses the verb दुखते with body part as subject: डोके दुखते. दर्द is a Hindi noun.

title: Marathi Personality Adjectives: Traits, Moods & Character

Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation, gender agreement notes and example sentences.
Personality words follow the same gender agreement as all adjectives: masculine ends in -ा, feminine in -ी, neuter in -े. Learn the citation form (masculine) and the pattern gives you all three.
tip: Learn in opposite pairs: धीर/उतावळा (patient/impatient), उत्साही/उदासीन (enthusiastic/apathetic), संवेदनशील/कठोर (sensitive/hard-hearted).

sections.heading: Core personality traits

Negative: उतावळा (impatient), उदासीन (apathetic), कठोर (hard/stern), स्वार्थी (selfish), अहंकारी (arrogant). Each agrees with the person described.

sections.heading: Gender agreement in action
paragraphs: तो धीर आहे (he is patient), ती धीर आहे (she is patient), ते धीर आहे (it/child is patient). The adjective ending changes: धीर (masc), धीर (fem - same), धीर (neut - same). For adjectives ending in -ा: उत्साही (masc), उत्साही (fem), उत्साही (neut). The pattern is consistent.

title: Marathi Time Expressions: Clock & Calendar
description: Marathi time vocabulary - clock, durations, frequency, calendar - with Hindi meanings and examples from Units 16, 18.
intro: Marathi time vocabulary from Units 16 and 18 covering three layers: the clock (तास, मिनिट, वाजले), durations (तास, मिनिट, सकाळ, दुपार, संध्याकाळ, रात्र), and frequency (नेहमी, कधीच, कधीकधी, रोज, अजून). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.

The grammar key: Marathi says the clock "has struck" - वाजले is the verb. साडे पाच वाजले = half past five (literally "five-and-a-half have struck"). Frequency adverbs (नेहमी, कधीच, रोज) sit immediately before the verb — Unit 18 drills this position.
tip: साडे + number + वाजले = half past. सवा + number + वाजले = quarter past. डेढ + number + वाजले = hour-and-a-half. The fraction + number + वाजले pattern covers all clock times.

sections.heading: The clock - वाजले frame
paragraphs: English "it is five o'clock" → Marathi पाच वाजले (five struck). English "half past five" → साडे पाच वाजले (five-and-a-half struck). The verb वाजले (struck) replaces both "is" and "o'clock". Quarter past: सवा पाच वाजले; hour-and-a-half: डेढ पाच वाजले.

sections.heading: Day parts & frequency
paragraphs: सकाळ (morning), दुपार (afternoon), संध्याकाळ (evening), रात्र (night). Frequency: नेहमी (always), रोज (daily), कधीकधी (sometimes), कधीच (never), अजून (still), आधीच (already). Position: adverb immediately before verb — मी रोज खेळतो, never मी खेळतो रोज.

mistakes.why: Marathi uses the verb वाजले (struck); बजे is Hindi.
Hindi कल does both; Marathi splits them. This is the #1 calendar false friend.

mistakes.right: Adverb before verb: मी रोज खेळतो (not मी खेळतो रोज)
mistakes.why: Unit 18 pattern — adverbs pre-verb, consistently.

mcq.explanation: साडे पाच वाजले — साडे = half, वाजले = struck.

mcq.explanation: उद्या = tomorrow. काल = yesterday — the trap.

mcq.explanation: नेहमी (nehmi) = always.

faq.answer: पाच वाजले — the verb वाजले (struck) replaces Hindi बजे.

faq.question: What is the biggest time trap for Hindi speakers?
faq.answer: काल means yesterday, not tomorrow. Tomorrow is उद्या. The verb वाजले (struck) replaces 'o'clock'.

title: Marathi Daily Expressions: Feelings, Adverbs & Ready Phrases
description: 46 Marathi phrases - feelings, adverbs, daily expressions - with Hindi meanings and examples.
intro: Forty-six Marathi phrases from the Phrases category (46) and Adverbs (30) covering feelings (मला आवडतं, मला भीती वाटते), adverbs (खरंच, नक्की, कदाचित, जवळजवळ), and ready-to-use daily expressions (काही हरकत नाही, बरोबर, चूक, पुन्हा सांगा, हळू बोला). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.

These are the phrases you hear and say every day — not grammar exercises, but the actual sentences Marathi speakers use. The Phrases category (46) and Adverbs category (30) overlap here to give you the most useful daily expressions in one place.
tip: मला … आवडतं for likes, मला … वाटते for feelings, खरंच/नक्की for emphasis, कदाचित for uncertainty. These four frames cover 80% of daily expressive sentences.

sections.heading: The feeling frames
paragraphs: मला … आवडतं (I like …), मला … वाटते (I feel …), मला … आहे (I have … — for hunger, thirst, fever). The dative मला marks the experiencer; the feeling is the subject. Hindi मुझे … है maps directly.

sections.heading: Emphasis & uncertainty adverbs
paragraphs: खरंच (really/truly), नक्की (surely/definitely), कदाचित (maybe/perhaps), जवळजवळ (almost). These sit right before the verb or clause they modify: खरंच चांगले आहे (it's really good), कदाचित तो येईल (maybe he will come).

sections.heading: Ready daily phrases
paragraphs: काही हरकत नाही (it's alright / no problem), बरोबर (correct/okay), चूक (wrong/mistake), पुन्हा सांगा (say again), हळू बोला (speak slowly), मला समजलं नाही (I didn't understand). These are the social lubricant of Marathi conversation.

mistakes.wrong: Using खरंच for "really" in all contexts
mistakes.right: खरंच = truly/really; नक्की = surely/definitely; use based on certainty level
mistakes.why: खरंच = really/truly (emphasizing truth); नक्की = surely/definitely (expressing certainty). They are not fully interchangeable.
The च particle negates: कधी (when) → कधीच (never). कधीकधी = sometimes is the positive form.

mistakes.right: बरोबर as agreement comes mid-sentence or as response; as adjective it agrees: बरोबर उत्तर (correct answer)
mistakes.why: बरोबर functions as both interjection ("Right!") and adjective ("correct"). Position depends on function.

mcq.explanation: काही हरकत नाही (kāhī harakat nāhī) — nothing wrong / it's alright.

faq.answer: खरंच = really/truly (emphasizing truth); नक्की = surely/definitely (expressing certainty). Both are emphasis adverbs but with different nuance.

title: Marathi Abstract Concepts: World, Time, Values & Ideas
description: 36 Marathi abstract words - जग, देश, भाषा, धर्म, भविष्य, मूल्य, गुणवत्ता, धैर्य, अनुभव - with Hindi meanings and philosophical examples.
intro: Thirty-six Marathi abstract words from the Abstract category: जग (world), देश (country), भाषा (language), धर्म (religion), भविष्य (future), भूतकाळ (past), परिणाम (result), मूल्य (value), गुणवत्ता (quality), धैर्य (patience/courage), अनुभव (experience), उद्देश (purpose), समस्या (problem), उपाय (solution), परिवर्तन (change). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a philosophical example sentence.

Many abstract words are shared Sanskrit loans (देश, धर्म, भाषा, इतिहास, भविष्य, संस्कृती) - identical to Hindi. The shifts are in the functional words: जग (world), परिणाम (result), उपाय (solution), धैर्य (patience). These are the words that elevate conversation from transactional to meaningful.
tip: Learn in semantic clusters: time (भविष्य, भूतकाळ, वर्तमान), value (मूल्य, गुणवत्ता, परिणाम), agency (उद्देश, उपाय, धैर्य, अनुभव). The Sanskrit loans are free; the Marathi-specific ones are the leverage.

sections.heading: Time & existence
paragraphs: भविष्य (future), भूतकाळ (past), वर्तमान (present), जग (world), अस्तित्व (existence). The triad भविष्य/भूतकाळ/वर्तमान mirrors Hindi exactly — free vocabulary.

sections.heading: Values & agency
paragraphs: मूल्य (value), गुणवत्ता (quality), परिणाम (result), उद्देश (purpose), उपाय (solution), धैर्य (patience/courage), अनुभव (experience), परिवर्तन (change). These are the words of serious conversation — decisions, planning, reflection.

mistakes.why: दुनिया is the Hindi/Urdu word; जग (jag) is the standard Marathi word for world.
Hindi भूतकाल vs Marathi भूतकाळ — the ला/काळ shift is systematic.

mistakes.right: समस्या = problem; अडचण = difficulty/obstacle; त्रास = trouble/distress
mistakes.why: Marathi distinguishes problem types: समस्या (formal problem), अडचण (practical difficulty), त्रास (distress).

mcq.question: World in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: जग (jag) — the standard Marathi word for world.

mcq.question: Future in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: भविष्य (bhaviṣya) — identical to Hindi, free vocabulary.

mcq.question: Patience/courage in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: धैर्य (dhairya) = patience/courage — covers both nuances.

faq.question: How many abstract words are on this page?
faq.answer: 36 — covering time, existence, values, agency and social concepts, each with Hindi meaning and philosophical example.

faq.question: Are abstract words similar to Hindi?
faq.answer: Most are shared Sanskrit loans (देश, धर्म, भाषा, इतिहास, भविष्य, संस्कृती) — identical. The Marathi-specific ones (जग, परिणाम, उपाय, धैर्य) are the high-leverage ones to learn.

title: Marathi Technology Words: Phone, Internet, Apps & Devices
description: 15 Marathi technology words — मोबाईल, संगणक, इंटरनेट, व्हायफाय, ऐप, व्हाट्सअॅप — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation, examples from Unit 12.
intro: Fifteen Marathi technology words from Unit 12 — the everyday digital vocabulary you need for phones, internet, apps and devices. Each entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence from the curriculum.

Most tech words are English loans written in Devanagari — the Marathi part is the spelling conventions (मोबाईल, व्हायफाय, व्हाट्सअॅप, बॅटरी) and the verb frames (फोन करा, मेसेज पाठवा, चार्ज करा, डाउनलोड करा). Learn the nouns once, add the verbs, and you have the full digital toolkit.
tip: मोबाईल, इंटरनेट, चार्ज, ऐप, बॅटरी — these are the same words, just Devanagari. The Marathi magic is in the verbs: फोन करा, मेसेज पाठवा, चार्ज करा, डाउनलोड करा।

sections.heading: Devices & connections — the nouns you already know
paragraphs: मोबाईल (mobile), संगणक (computer), इंटरनेट (internet), व्हायफाय (WiFi), कॅमरा (camera), बॅटरी (battery), चार्जर (charger), स्क्रीन (screen), सिम कार्ड (SIM card) — these are English loans in Devanagari. The spelling flags: मोबाईल (ि + ल), व्हायफाय (ॅ), व्हाट्सअॅप (ॅ), बॅटरी (ॅ), कॅमरा (ॅ).

sections.heading: Actions — the Marathi verb frames
paragraphs: फोन करा (call), मेसेज पाठवा (send message), चार्ज करा (charge), डाउनलोड करा (download), इंस्टॉल करा (install), डिलीट करा (delete), सर्च करा (search), रीस्टार्ट करा (restart), कनेक्ट करा (connect), लॉगिन करा (login). Pattern: noun + करा. The noun is the loanword; करा does the work.

mistakes.why: Marathi writes the English loan as मोबाईल; the Hindi spelling मोबाइल uses the wrong vowel sign.

mistakes.wrong: Saying इंटरनेट काम करत आहे for "internet is working"
mistakes.why: चालू = on/working; बंद = off. चालू/बंद is the standard on/off pair.
Marathi uses ॅ (short e) for the English 'a' in WhatsApp; व्हाट्सएप uses Hindi vowel.

mcq.question: Call me in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: मला फोन करा — to me, call (dative + verb).

mcq.question: My battery is low in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: माझी बॅटरी कमी आहे — battery is feminine, so माझी/कमी.

mcq.question: Download the app in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: ऐप डाउनलोड करा — loanword + करा.

faq.question: How do you say mobile in Marathi?
faq.answer: मोबाईल — with ि and ल, not मोबाइल. The candrabindu is not used here; just the spelling convention.

faq.question: What is WhatsApp in Marathi?
faq.answer: व्हाट्सअॅप — with ॅ (short e) for the English 'a' sound.

title: Marathi Bird Names: 12 Birds from Sparrow to Peacock
description: 12 Marathi bird names — चिमणी, मोर, कोयल, पोपट, कोबळ, गरुड — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation, examples and cultural notes.
intro: Twelve Marathi bird names from the Bol Marathi curriculum — from the everyday चिमणी (sparrow) and कोबळ (pigeon) to the majestic मोर (peacock) and गरुड (eagle). Each entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.
Several Hindi bird names shift systematically in Marathi: कबूतर → कोबळ, तोता → पोपट, उल्लू → उड्डाण, कौवा → काक. The table below maps each shift so you learn the pattern once.
tip: कोबळ, पोपट, काक, शकुन — these four shifts cover the most common birds. Learn the pattern once: retroflex + vowel shift.

sections.heading: Everyday birds you will see
paragraphs: चिमणी (sparrow), कोबळ (pigeon), काक (crow) — these three are everywhere in Maharashtra. चिमणी छोटी आहे (the sparrow is small), कोबळ खिडकीवर बसले (pigeon sat on the window), काक कावतो (crow caws) — the curriculum sentences put them in daily life.

sections.heading: Cultural & iconic birds
paragraphs: मोर (peacock) — India's national bird, नाचतो आहे in monsoon. कोयल (koel) — the spring singer, बसंतऋतूचे प्रतीक. गरुड (eagle) — mythological vehicle of Vishnu. शकुन (kite/hawk) — high flier. Each carries cultural weight beyond vocabulary.

sections.heading: The systematic shifts
paragraphs: कबूतर → कोबळ, तोता → पोपट, उल्लू → उड्डाण, कौवा → काक, बगुला → बगळा. The pattern: Hindi retroflex + vowel shifts to Marathi ळ or ण or shortened form. Learn these five; the rest are identical (मोर, हंस, कोयल, गरुड, पक्षी).

mistakes.why: Systematic shift: Hindi कबूतर → Marathi कोबळ. The retroflex + vowel change is regular.
तोता → पोपट follows the same retroflex shift pattern.
पक्षी is the category word. For specific birds, use कोबळ, पोपट, मोर, etc.

mcq.question: How do you say "peacock" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: मोर (mor) — national bird, identical to Hindi.

mcq.question: What is पोपट?
mcq.explanation: पोपट (popaṭ) = parrot; Hindi तोता shifts to पोपट.

mcq.question: Which bird is कोयल?
mcq.explanation: कोयल (koyal) = koel/cuckoo, the spring singer.

faq.question: How many bird words are on this page?
faq.answer: 12 — from everyday birds (sparrow, pigeon, crow) to cultural icons (peacock, koel, eagle), each with Hindi meaning, pronunciation and a sentence.

faq.question: What is the Marathi word for parrot?
faq.answer: पोपट (popaṭ) — Hindi तोता shifts to पोपट in Marathi.

title: Marathi Shapes & Geometry: Circle, Square, Triangle & More
description: 12 Marathi shape words — गोल, चौकोन, त्रिकोण, आयत, वर्तुळ, अष्टकोण — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation, examples and geometry terms.
intro: Twelve Marathi shape and geometry words — from the basic गोल (circle) and चौकोन (square) to polygons like त्रिकोण (triangle), षट्कोण (hexagon), अष्टकोण (octagon), plus the formal terms वर्तुळ (circle) and कोन (angle). Each entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.

Several Hindi shape words shift in Marathi: चौकोर → चौकोन, वृत्त → वर्तुळ, कोण → कोन. The Sanskrit-rooted terms (त्रिकोण, अष्टकोण, षट्कोण) are identical. The table below maps each so you learn the shifts and the shared terms together.
tip: त्रिकोण, षट्कोण, अष्टकोण — the -कोण (angle) suffix builds polygon names: त्रि(3)+कोण, षट्(6)+कोण, अष्ट(8)+कोण. Learn the numbers; the shapes follow.

sections.heading: Basic shapes — everyday vocabulary
paragraphs: गोल (circle/round), चौकोन (square), त्रिकोण (triangle), आयत (rectangle), अंडाकृती (oval), अर्धवर्तुळ (semicircle). These are the shapes you use daily — चेंडू गोल आहे (ball is round), मेज चौकोन आहे (table is square), अंडी अंडाकृती आहे (egg is oval).

sections.heading: Formal geometry terms
paragraphs: वर्तुळ (circle — formal), कोन (angle/corner), त्रिभुज (triangle — alt), षट्कोण (hexagon), अष्टकोण (octagon). The -कोण suffix means angle/corner: त्रि(3)+कोण, षट्(6)+कोण, अष्ट(8)+कोण. Hindi shares these Sanskrit forms identically.

sections.heading: The systematic shifts
paragraphs: चौकोर → चौकोन (ण shift), वृत्त → वर्तुळ (ळ shift), कोण → कोन (shortening). These three shifts cover the core geometry vocabulary differences from Hindi.

mistakes.why: Hindi चौकोर → Marathi चौकोन. The ण shift is systematic in geometry words.
वृत्त → वर्तुळ (ळ shift). गोल is the everyday word; वर्तुळ is the geometry term.
आकार is the category word. गोल is one specific shape.

mcq.question: How do you say "triangle" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: त्रिकोण (trikon) — tri(3) + कोण(angle). Identical to Hindi.

mcq.question: What is वर्तुळ?
mcq.explanation: वर्तुळ (vartul) — formal geometry term for circle; everyday word is गोल.

mcq.question: Hexagon in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: षट्कोण (ṣaṭkoṇ) — षट्(6) + कोण(angle).

faq.question: How many shape words are on this page?
faq.answer: 12 — basic shapes (circle, square, triangle, rectangle, oval) plus formal geometry terms (circle, angle, hexagon, octagon), each with Hindi meaning and sentence.

faq.question: What is the Marathi word for circle?
faq.answer: गोल (gol) for everyday use; वर्तुळ (vartul) for formal geometry. The Hindi वृत्त shifts to वर्तुळ in Marathi.
